snippet.title: Real Boxing 2: Remastered | Launch Trailer | Steam
snippet.description:
🥊 Real Boxing 2: Remastered is out!🥊
No rules. No mercy. Forge your fighter, take on the world, and prove you're the true champ in this brutal remaster of a boxing legend.

💥 Remastered graphics & rebalanced gameplay
💥 Customize your boxer—tattoos, outfits, even nose shape!
💥 Face wild bosses like… a clown, Santa, and a stone golem?!
💥 Play mini-games to boost your stats
💥 KO your way to glory with powerful combos & special moves

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3811350/Real_Boxing_2_Remastered/
